scope: Mac ChatGPT subscription, eight isolated CLI session stores, two concurrent workers, repeated previous regular closing quotes
usage_measurement_scope: Whole signed-in account; concurrent app activity also consumes usage. Percentage difference is not an attributable per-test bill.
limitations: Short bounded test, not long-term quota or refresh validation.
Separate session stores/workspaces and own marker recall are not complete OS/mount/API authorization isolation.
Eight operational test sessions use one configured model; production personas/backend/memory lifecycle are not exercised.
Only AAPL represents the stock category; QQQ/TQQQ/EWC are tested. Full 50+20 stock universe is not tested.
Round 1 Yahoo native web calls returned 429; round 2 Yahoo visible browser excerpts were read by a collector then supplied to the model.
Market closed: 60-second regular quote freshness and executable BBO/size remain unvalidated.
No Hetzner changes, paper fills or real trades performed.
